source: Owner-requested bug report from a ChatGPT chat, filed to this repository as audits/2026-10-15-romantic-love-answer-target-mismatch.md (pull request 381, 'Send bug report to uda lane for mismatched original answer'). The maintainer disposition is recorded in that file.
problem: Asked whether Italians stay in love with the same partner much longer than Americans, a ChatGPT answer opened with a sentence that stated the divorce difference and then said there was no convincing evidence on love itself, made divorce and marriage rates its main comparison and table, and closed by offering the owner's own question back as 'the particularly interesting question'. The owner had to point out that it was their question.
owner_corrections: Yeah that was my question not a more interesting question...
failure_mechanisms: Inferred from the report's excerpts, not established: proxy promotion during evidence selection or synthesis. The easiest evidence to find (divorce and marriage statistics) became the main comparison although the answer itself said it did not measure the target.

Inferred from the excerpts: no final comparison with the question. Nothing compared the answer's first claim and closing with the question's wording, so the closing re-labeled the target as a new question.
Activation, not established: the report does not say whether the chat loaded this architecture. ChatGPT chats load the owner's ChatGPT instructions and memory, not this repository.
existing_coverage: patterns/reasoning-selection.md exact-target preservation (2026-09-12) forbids substituting correlates and tests proposed distinctions, but says nothing about answer order, proxy labeling, or the closing.

patterns/reasoning-selection.md Same relation to the end (2026-09-30) covers replacement tests and 'better questions' an answer proposes, worded for claim evaluation; it does not say that the asked question may never be offered back as new.
patterns/reasoning-selection.md predicate-alignment check covers corrections and rebuttals, not answers to questions.
recurring_finding_check: Fourth change for the target-substitution class (2026-09-12 exact-target rule, 2026-09-13 predicate-alignment check, 2026-09-30 same-relation extension, 2026-10-15). The deciding mechanism is the answering model reading the question, which is the right place for a semantic judgment (pattern-matching fit check); a word or keyword gate is not. The earlier changes each named a context where the target can slip. This one does not add a context: it moves the check to the answer's first claim and closing, which every answer passes through. The remaining gap is activation on surfaces that do not load this repository, which no wording here can close.
required_behavior: Before sending an answer to a conceptual, comparative, or empirical question, compare the question with the answer's first substantive claim and its closing.
The first claim is about the target; when there is no direct evidence on the target, say so first and plainly. A needed clarifying question or a one-clause scope note may come before it.

Easier-to-find evidence that measures a proxy may follow as labeled context with what it cannot show; it is not the main comparison, table, or verdict, though an inference from it may be offered when labeled as indirect with its link to the target named.
When the question asks about the measured thing itself, that measure is the target; proxies are not banned.
No closing, open question, or suggested follow-up presents the user's own question as new or more interesting; if it stays unresolved, say that the user's question is the one still unresolved.
When the user says an answer missed their question, their account of what they asked governs; this settles which question to answer, not any factual claim, which is still checked before conceding.
regression: Case A of evals/answer-target-preservation.json: the romantic-love question is answered on love first, with divorce as a labeled proxy and no 'more interesting question' closing. Case B: the marriage-duration question uses marriage and divorce data directly.
scope: Answers to questions on every surface that loads this repository. Semantic judgment only: no fail-closed gate, no keyword detection, no new authority, no ban on labeled proxies, and no requirement to narrate the check.

origin.notes: The owner corrected the answer and asked for the report. The wording of the check is the maintainer's, from the report's requested disposition.

evaluation.run: One run on 2026-10-15 recorded in the fixture: Claude Sonnet with and without an earlier wording of the rule, graded blind against the report's pass and fail criteria. Both passed all five cases, so the cases did not discriminate and the run does not show the rule's effect. The final wording and case E's last fail condition were added after the run and have not been run. The setup (no tools, short answers) cannot reproduce a researched answer with a table. Not run on ChatGPT.

nonclaims: Text-presence tests do not show that any agent applies the check.
The one model run passed with and without the rule, so it is not evidence that the rule changes behavior.
